description:
HushPine v0.2.0 has 101 patches for PineDrama 47.7.3 (com.ss.android.ttmd.video).

Built for PineDrama 47.7.3. Open on Home starts PineDrama on Home every time instead of Discover. Needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer.

All 101 patches applied to the supported APK. This bundle ran through a whole-app walk of PineDrama on a signed-in Galaxy S22 with no crash.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. Refresh the HushPine source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a PineDrama APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

### Features

* `Open on Home` (on by default) starts PineDrama on the Home tab every time. It used to open on Discover for some accounts.

### Changes

* Retargeted to PineDrama 47.7.3 (version code 2024707030). All the patches apply to it, and every patch that hooks the app's own code was checked again against 47.7.3's code. 47.6.3 isn't a target anymore, so update PineDrama before you repatch.
